match.description: The method Kibana uses to determine which sessions to invalidate. If it is `all`, all existing sessions will be invalidated. If it is `query`, only the sessions that match the query will be invalidated.

type.description: The authentication provide type. For example: `basic`, `token`, `saml`, `oidc`, `kerberos`, or `pki`.

provider.description: The authentication providers that will have their user sessions invalidated.

username.description: The username that will have its sessions invalidated.

query.description: The query that Kibana uses to match the sessions to invalidate when the `match` parameter is set to `query`.
